scripts.test:server: pnpm run test:server:unit && pnpm run test:server:integration && pnpm run test:server:service
scripts.test:backend: pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm --filter @tx-holdem-coach/contracts run build && pnpm run test:server
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @tx-holdem-coach/contracts run build && oxlint apps/server/src apps/server/test apps/server/scripts apps/web/src packages/contracts/src packages/contracts/test --report-unused-disable-directives
scripts.simplify:light: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.simplify:deep: pnpm run lint && pnpm run report:knip && pnpm run report:duplication && pnpm run verify && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @tx-holdem-coach/server run verify:migration-assets
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:repository-map && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:backend
